# Bloxorz.gba level data

`levels.json` is copied from [`jacobcoughenour/bloxorz_gba`](https://github.com/jacobcoughenour/bloxorz_gba/blob/8d552f867c06caa8bc9953eefa13ecb2bb9d8edf/game/levels.json) at commit `8d552f867c06caa8bc9953eefa13ecb2bb9d8edf`.

Only the level definitions are imported. The data is converted to TypeScript by `tools/import-bloxorz-levels.mjs`. See `LICENSE` for the upstream MIT license.
